:::{#cor-var-mse-bias}
#### Standard error squared equals MSE minus squared bias

The squared standard error is what remains of the mean squared error
after the squared bias is removed:

$$\sqf{\SE{\hth}} = \mselr{\hth} - \sqf{\bias{\hth}}$$

:::

::: proof

Start from @thm-mse-bias-variance:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mselr{\hth} &= \sqf{\bias{\hth}} + \Var{\hth}
&& \text{(MSE equals bias squared plus variance)}\\
\Var{\hth} &= \mselr{\hth} - \sqf{\bias{\hth}}
&& \text{(subtract $\sqf{\bias{\hth}}$ from both sides)}\\
\sqf{\SE{\hth}} &= \mselr{\hth} - \sqf{\bias{\hth}}
&& \text{($\Var{\hth} = \sqf{\SD{\hth}} = \sqf{\SE{\hth}}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
